jobs.title: Head of Domain, Technology Development
jobs.description:
**Who we are:**
===============


Geotab ® is a global leader in IoT and connected transportation and certified "Great Place to Work™." We are a company of diverse and talented individuals who work together to help businesses grow and succeed, and increase the safety and sustainability of our communities.

Geotab is advancing security, connecting commercial vehicles to the internet and providing web\-based analytics to help customers better manage their fleets. Geotab's open platform and Geotab Marketplace ®, offering hundreds of third\-party solution options, allows both small and large businesses to automate operations by integrating vehicle data with their other data assets. Processing billions of data points a day, Geotab leverages data analytics and machine learning to improve productivity, optimize fleets through the reduction of fuel consumption, enhance driver safety and achieve strong compliance to regulatory changes.

Our team is growing and we're looking for people who follow their passion, think differently and want to make an impact. Ours is a fast paced, ever changing environment. Geotabbers accept that challenge and are willing to take on new tasks and activities \- ones that may not always be described in the initial job description. Join us for a fulfilling career with opportunities to innovate, great benefits, and our fun and inclusive work culture. Reach your full potential with Geotab. To see what it's like to be a Geotabber, check out our blog and follow us @InsideGeotab on Instagram.
**Who you are:**
================



Geotab is looking for entrepreneurial product and business leaders to head our domains – focused teams that each own a customer outcome and the business results that come with it. As a Head of Domain, you'll own the strategy, roadmap and results for your area, lead a multi\-disciplinary team of product managers, designers and engineers, and turn customer problems into products that customers adopt and pay for.


**What you'll do:**
===================



This is a role for someone who has **built and sold something**: a leader who measures success by business results, not by what shipped, and who uses AI to change how work gets done. You'll report to Geotab's Technology Development Board and operate with real autonomy as the business owner of your domain.



We welcome applicants nationwide! If you're based near one of our office hubs, this role follows our hybrid model, blending the comfort of working from home with regular on\-site days to connect and collaborate.


*This is an evergreen posting. We're building a pipeline of exceptional leaders for current and future domain leadership opportunities across Technology Development.*


**How you'll make an impact:**
==============================


* **Own the outcome.** Set the vision, strategy and roadmap for your domain and be accountable for its primary business results – adoption, revenue, retention and customer impact.
* **Run it like a business.** Make clear build, buy and partner decisions, prioritize by customer and revenue impact, and say no when the return isn't there.
* **Stay close to customers.** Ground your team in customers' real experience to find the problems worth solving, and work with sales, support and partners to bring solutions to market.
* **Lead the AI shift.** Redesign how your domain works around AI to move faster, and help others across the organization do the same.
* **Build a high\-performing team.** Hire the right talent without settling, place people where their strengths matter most, set a clear and high bar, and develop the next generation of leaders.
* **Work across Geotab.** Partner closely with platform, segment and other domain leaders, contribute beyond your own goals, and help shape strategy with the Technology Development Board.
* **Manage your investment.** Own your domain's people and budget plan, make investment cases, and report on results and risks to the board.

**What you'll bring to this role:**
===================================


* 10\+ years of experience in product management, product engineering, or related customer\-facing product roles.
* 5\+ years of senior product and people leadership with cross\-functional scope and direct accountability for customer\-facing business outcomes.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent combination of education and work experience).
* Strong product leadership capability with demonstrated ability to define and execute customer\-facing product strategy tied to measurable business outcomes, with P\&L literacy and revenue attribution.
* Cross\-functional leadership experience managing teams across product management, product design, and product engineering disciplines, with proven capability in identifying and coaching high\-potential leaders.
* Excellent stakeholder management, change readiness, and communication skills to effectively collaborate with platform teams, segment leads, and executive leadership in evolving organizational structures.
* Familiarity with modern product discovery, validation practices, and engineering practices (CI/CD, cloud\-native delivery, agile), alongside the ability to redesign domain workflows around AI to compress effort.


**Please note: Geotab does not accept agency resumes and is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes. Please do not forward resumes to Geotab employees.**

jobs.title: Director, AI Engineering
jobs.description:
You are as unique as your background, experience and point of view. Here, you’ll be encouraged, empowered and challenged to be your best self. You'll work with dynamic colleagues \- experts in their fields \- who are eager to share their knowledge with you. Your leaders will inspire and help you reach your potential and soar to new heights. Every day, you'll have new and exciting opportunities to make life brighter for our Clients \- who are at the heart of everything we do.  



  

At Sun Life, we're driven by our Purpose: helping our Clients achieve lifetime financial security and live healthier lives. Our values shape how we work: caring, authentic, bold, inspiring, and impactful.  



  

When you join Sun Life, you'll work with passionate colleagues and empowering leaders who support your growth and celebrate your contributions, so you can make a meaningful difference in our Clients' lives.  



  

Discover how you can make a difference in the lives of individuals, families and communities around the world.  



  

**Job Description:**

The Director of AI Engineering, Corporate IT leads the engineering of artificial intelligence for internal enterprise delivery, from strategy and architecture through production delivery. This role builds secure, scalable and responsible AI capabilities that modernize enterprise systems, automate IT operations and improve employee productivity.  



  

**What will you do?**

  

**AI Strategy \& Roadmap**

* Own the Corporate IT AI strategy and roadmap, aligned with CIO and enterprise priorities.
* Lead intake, value assessment and prioritization of AI use cases across functions such as Actuarial, Risk, Compliance, Human Resources, Finance, Legal, Procurement etc.
* Manage AI licensing, vendor contracts and cloud spend within the IT budget.
* Rationalize AI tools, reduce duplication and address unapproved or shadow AI use.
* Assess emerging capabilities, including copilots, agents and SaaS AI features, for enterprise fit.

**Enterprise AI Patterns, Architecture \& Integration**

* Define AI patterns and align them with Enterprise Architecture standards.
* Guide integration of AI with collaboration platforms and enterprise data services.
* Govern build\-versus\-buy decisions across packaged AI, SaaS capabilities and custom solutions.
* Align AI solutions with identity and access management, single sign\-on, API gateways and enterprise data platforms.
* Act as the AI design authority in relevant architecture review forums.

**AI Platform, AIOps \& Automation**

* Build and operate enterprise AI platform capabilities, including LLM gateways, retrieval\-augmented generation, vector stores, prompt management and evaluation.
* Deliver AIOps capabilities such as event correlation, anomaly detection and automated remediation.
* Apply AI to IT service management, including ticket triage, routing, virtual agents and knowledge search.
* Implement MLOps and LLMOps pipelines integrated with IT change and release management.
* Monitor model quality, drift, hallucination risk, service performance and inference cost.

**Security, Risk \& Responsible AI**

* Embed information security, data classification and data loss prevention requirements across AI services.
* Protect AI solutions against data leakage, prompt injection and model abuse.
* Partner with Risk, Legal, Compliance and Privacy to establish and operate AI controls.
* Support privacy, SOX, model\-risk and audit requirements for AI\-enabled corporate processes.
* Maintain an accurate inventory of AI solutions and an approved\-tools catalogue.

**People, Talent \& Adoption**

* Lead AI engineering, platform and automation teams and establish clear accountabilities.
* Design roles, career paths and team structures that build sustainable AI capability within Corporate IT.
* Mentor IT employees in AI engineering and secure, responsible AI practices.
* Drive employee AI adoption and literacy in partnership with corporate function owners.
* Manage strategic partners and managed service providers and hold them accountable for outcomes.

**IT Service Delivery \& Operations**

* Deliver AI initiatives through established portfolio, change, release and governance processes.
* Own service\-level expectations, support models, runbooks and operational readiness for AI services.
* Partner with corporate function owners to define outcomes and realize measurable value.
* Report value, risk, delivery and spend to the CIO and IT leadership.
* Lead change management and communications for AI rollouts.

**What do you need to succeed?**

* Demonstrated hands\-on experience building and delivering artificial intelligence or machine learning solutions into production, supported by a strong foundation in software engineering, data engineering or machine learning.
* Experience designing AI engineering patterns and guiding engineering teams through technical implementation while remaining actively involved in solution development.
* Proficiency with Python and experience with data integration, data pipelines or extract, transform and load processes.
* Experience with cloud AI services and application programming interfaces on Amazon Web Services, Microsoft Azure or both.
* Practical knowledge of generative AI, large language models, retrieval\-augmented generation, model evaluation and production monitoring.
* Experience navigating information security, data protection, responsible AI and technology\-governance requirements in a complex enterprise environment.
* Ability to explain complex technical recommendations to engineering teams, senior leaders and business stakeholders, mentor colleagues and build alignment across teams.
* Experience working in a regulated or highly governed enterprise environment.
* Amazon Web Services, Microsoft Azure or AI\-related training or certification.

**Job Description**

**What is the opportunity?**


Join RBC's Enterprise Performance Management team to provide strategic financial advice to senior leadership, including the CFO, Group Executives, and Board of Directors. You'll deliver timely, insightful analysis that informs critical business decisions and supports long\-term bank performance. Working across all platforms and business segments, you'll develop strong relationships with diverse stakeholders while driving continuous improvement in how we measure and optimize enterprise performance.

**What will you do?**

* Build knowledge and provide an integrated view of enterprise performance through preparation for senior management.
* Ensure timely and accurate delivery of strategic reports that inform executive decision\-making
* Synthesize enterprise performance data, strategic insights, competitive intelligence, and market intelligence into strategic briefs and deep dives for senior leadership
* Deliver high quality work that is produced efficiently within tight timelines.
* Leverage AI and advanced analytics to surface insights from enterprise performance and market data. Translate AI outputs into strategic narratives and recommendations that drive executive action.
* Support key RBC enterprise priorities while establishing, monitoring, and maintaining effective plans and controls to ensure that they are completed on time.

**What do you need to succeed?**

**Must\-have**

* 5\+ years of progressive experience in strategy consulting, banking, performance management, investor relations, or financial services.
* CFA, CPA or equivalent financial services credentials

* MBA or advanced degree in Finance, Economics, Business, or related field
* Experience with competitive intelligence functions
* Familiarity with AI/ML capabilities and data analytics tools
* Translating data and AI outputs into compelling strategic narratives that influence enterprise\-wide decisions.

We thrive on the challenge to be our best, progressive thinking to keep growing, and working together to deliver trusted advice to help our clients thrive and communities prosper. jobs.title: Director, Strategy
jobs.description:
**Job Description**

**What is the Opportunity?**


This role establishes a strong link between Role Design, Technology partners, and Personal and Commercial Banking partners to enable the optimization, development, and delivery of digital tools and applications used by Canadian Banking advisors.

 **Primary Focus**

* Drive horizontal strategy across all CRM and Branch Platforms to ensure integrated and consistent advisor experiences
* Work across LOBs, including Personal Bank, Commercial and Private Banking on defining strategic vision and transformational roadmap for next generation of use cases and capabilities
* Establishing the rigor for the ongoing management and evolution of the platform and realization of business benefits.
* Identify, assess, and proactively mitigate risks, developing contingency plans and ensure effective risk management across the portfolio.
* Manage budgets and financial planning in collaboration with finance and business management teams.
* Track approved funding spend, forecast future needs, and ensure cost efficiency across the delivery portfolio.
* Define and track product OKRs and KPIs, and drive the team to achieve them
* Ensure incremental adoption of relevant Client360 capabilities and further introduction of capabilities contained within Salesforce Financial Services Cloud®
* Staying up to date with the FSC products roadmap
* Advocate on behalf of the advisor community in the development of enterprise tools further contributing to Advisor efficiency and experience
* Driving collaboration with key internal functional partners
* Responsible for strategic alignment across major, Big Rock/large initiatives and digitization with Client360 Platform.
* Ensure technology roadmaps align with advisor needs, RBC strategic direction and enable engagement across preferred channels
* Establish and maintain strategic governance and reporting across platforms, driving alignment between business objectives and technology delivery

 **Secondary Focus**

* Collaborate with AI team partners to integrate Actionable insights into the Advisor’s path into Client360 (and other Advisor platforms) for enabling pre\-dive, post\-dive and in the moment efficiencies and effectiveness
* Lead rapid POC development cycles with authority to "fail fast / scale fast," designing multi\-agent interactions across vendor agents, enterprise agents, and native/internal agents to AI\-enable advisors through integration to the existing suite of technologies used by advisors
* Act as Integrator to Client360 / Advisor Platform for agentic workflows—owning use case shaping through validated solution patterns, defining success metrics, and driving iteration based on advisor feedback and usage metrics

 **What Will You Do?**

  

* Establish and maintain strategic direction across CRM and Branch Platforms, ensuring consistency and alignment with advisor needs
* Advocate on behalf of the advisor community in enterprise tool development and provide ongoing feedback loops
* Develop business\-centric programs and reporting that enhance daily advisor operations
* Identify stakeholder needs, negotiate priorities across competing interests, and collaborate with developers/partners to implement requirements effectively
* Keep business and technology stakeholders apprised of roadmap status and gather feedback
* Deploy processes and technologies that safeguard Advisors and Clients (compliance and regulatory requirements)
* Conduct advisor research and act as the voice of the Advisor community in platform development
* Negotiate and prioritize enhancements to mitigate technical and financial risk
* Partner with Technology, Procurement, and third\-party vendors to execute strategic initiatives

 **What Do You Need to Succeed?**

 **Must Have:**

* **Deep Expertise in Salesforce Financial Services Cloud (FSC) Capabilities:**


Demonstrates comprehensive knowledge of Salesforce FSC platform architecture, features, and capabilities (e.g., financial account management, financial deals, wealth management, customer data platforms). The ideal candidate should have hands\-on experience leveraging FSC to drive business outcomes, understand current and emerging FSC capabilities, and possess the ability to assess how these capabilities can inform and accelerate the evolution of Client360\. This includes staying current with Salesforce product roadmaps and identifying opportunities to integrate new FSC innovations into Client360's strategic direction.

* **Business Strategy \& Bridge from Strategy to Implementation**


Exhibits strong strategic thinking combined with pragmatic execution capabilities. The candidate must be able to develop comprehensive business strategies aligned with organizational objectives while maintaining a keen understanding of implementation realities. This includes translating strategic visions into actionable roadmaps, managing stakeholder expectations, prioritizing initiatives based on business impact and resource constraints, and ensuring accountability for delivery. Experience in leading cross\-functional teams to execute complex transformation programs is essential.

* **Expert\-Level Understanding of Client360 – Depth of Implemented Capabilities**


Possesses deep, hands\-on knowledge of Client360's current functionality, architecture, and implementations across diverse user groups and business units. The candidate should understand how different user personas leverage Client360, identify capability gaps, recognize overlaps, and articulate both strengths and limitations. This expertise enables informed decision\-making about platform enhancements, feature prioritization, and strategic investments. The ability to draw on real\-world implementation examples to validate strategy is critical.

* **Exceptional Executive Communication \& Presentation Skills**


Capable of distilling complex technical and strategic concepts into compelling, clear narratives for C\-suite and board\-level audiences.

jobs.title: VP, Financial Planning & Analysis
jobs.description:
**About Us:**

  

Opensity Solutions is the largest tech‑enabled managed services organization serving leading law firms, financial institutions and professional services firms. At Opensity, we provide integrated operational platforms, automation and advisory services that enable clients to modernize operating models, reduce cost and accelerate growth. Our capabilities include IT and technology solutions, document processing and administrative support, marketing and communications, billing and AP/AR services, records and information governance, workflow automation, consulting and hospitality and facilities services.  

  



**Our Mission:**

  

Our mission is to provide modernized technology platforms, elevated technology support, and valuable insights, empowering our clients to excel in what they do best.

  

Opensity Solutions is the largest end\-to\-end, tech\-enabled managed services organization focused on serving leading law firms, financial institutions and professional services firms.

  

Launched in 2026 through the combination of K2 Services, Epiq GBTS and Forrest Solutions, Opensity brings together more than 4,500 professionals, 500\+ clients and over $400 million in combined annual revenue, with operations across the United States, Canada, India and the Philippines.

  

Our mission is to provide modernized technology platforms, elevated technology support and valuable insights, empowering our clients to excel in what they do best.

  

Opensity is backed by Renovus Capital Partners, a leading private equity sponsor with deep experience investing in and scaling technology\-enabled services businesses.

  

For more information, visit **opensitysolutions.com**.

 **The Opportunity**


We are seeking a **Vice President, Financial Planning \& Analysis** to lead enterprise\-wide planning, forecasting, management reporting and business performance analytics. Reporting to the **Chief Financial Officer**, this role will be a key partner to executive leadership, business unit leaders and our private equity sponsor. The VP, FP\&A will help build a scalable, data\-driven FP\&A function and play an important role in Opensity's continued growth, M\&A activity and long\-term value creation.

 **Key Responsibilities**

* Lead annual budgeting, forecasting and long\-range planning across the organization.
* Own monthly and quarterly management reporting, variance analysis and executive performance reviews.
* Develop actionable financial and operational KPIs across revenue, margin, headcount, productivity, cash flow and profitability.
* Build robust recurring revenue analytics, including bookings, backlog, retention, churn, expansion and customer\-level performance.
* Partner with business leaders to improve forecast accuracy, financial accountability and operating performance.
* Lead customer, service\-line and business\-unit profitability analysis to support pricing, investment and resource allocation decisions.
* Drive automation and modernization of FP\&A, including dashboards, reporting, forecasting and data analysis.
* Support the CFO with Board, lender and private equity sponsor reporting.
* Support M\&A diligence, integration, synergy tracking and post\-acquisition performance management.
* Help maintain a strong, diligence\-ready Finance organization and support future refinancing, recapitalization or exit processes.
* Lead and develop the FP\&A team.

 **Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in finance, Accounting, Economics or a related field.
* 10\+ years of progressive Finance experience, including significant FP\&A leadership experience.
* Private equity\-backed company experience required.
* Experience working through a private equity exit, sale process, recapitalization or similar transaction strongly preferred.
* Strong experience with recurring revenue businesses and associated KPIs and analytics.
* Meaningful M\&A and post\-acquisition integration experience required.
* Strong data analytics capabilities with demonstrated experience automating financial reporting and analysis.
* Experience in technology\-enabled services, managed services, professional services, business services or SaaS strongly preferred.

The Canadian Aboriginal and Minority Supplier Council (CAMSC) is a not\-for\-profit organization headquartered in Toronto. CAMSC is seeking an experienced, hands\-on Director of Finance \& Operations to lead financial management and strengthen organizational operations. The ideal candidate will have senior management experience in a dynamic setting. The role requires outstanding organizational, communication, and leadership skills and an ability to develop innovative solutions that push boundaries.

**Position Summary** 

financial management, ensure compliance for grant\-funded programs, and oversee daily operations. This senior role combines strategic financial leadership with operational oversight, managing two direct reports, vendor relationships, and execution of annual goals. The ideal candidate will possess the ability to proactively develop multi\-year plans to improve efficiency, increase revenue, and reduce costs as needed in accordance with the goals in our Strategic Plan.

**Scope and Responsibilities** 

Key responsibilities

* Oversee accounting functions: accounts payable/receivable, payroll oversight, general ledger maintenance, and month\-end close.
* Prepare and present monthly and quarterly financial statements to the Executive team.
* Lead annual budget development, forecasting, and variance analysis.
* Manage grant financial reporting, restricted fund tracking, compliance, and audit preparation.
* Support fundraising with proposal budgets and sponsorship reporting.
* Implement and maintain internal controls, policies, and financial procedures.
* Supervise two direct reports; hire, train, and manage performance.
* Manage vendor relationships, contracts, procurement, and service\-level expectations.
* Oversee day\-to\-day operations (administrative, IT, vendor services) and drive process improvements.
* Develop and track annual operational goals and lead cross\-team projects.
* Responsible for the day\-to\-day operational activities, including staff financial management, strategic analysis, business planning, funding agreements, and budgeting.
* Overseeing current and future capital planning and projects, including coordination with consultants and internal staff to manage projects, equipment purchases, service contracts, etc.
* Collaborating with senior managers to develop and manage the annual and multi\-year budget based on the Strategic Plan, with guidance from the Executive Team. Providing support and guidance to the rest of the management team.
* Overseeing third\-party service providers for information technology systems and information management systems.
* Developing and implementing policies and programs for administrative, financial, facility operations, and building security.
* Overseeing and ensuring financial reporting compliance with all granting agencies as appropriate.
* Actively participating in relevant organizational committees.
* Promoting a positive corporate culture, and experienced with employment engagement strategies.
* People leadership accountabilities for managers, contractors, and other positions as assigned.

**Qualifications**

* Minimum 5 years management experience in finance or operations, including supervising staff.
* Hands\-on experience with month\-end close, financial statements, budgeting, and forecasting.

* Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or related field required.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills for non\-finance audiences and boards.
* Commitment to CAMSC’s mission and values.

We’re building a relationship\-oriented bank for the modern world. We need talented, passionate professionals who are dedicated to doing what’s right for our clients.


At CIBC, we embrace your strengths and your ambitions, so you are empowered at work. Our team members have what they need to make a meaningful impact and are truly valued for who they are and what they contribute.


To learn more about CIBC, please visit CIBC.com


**What you'll be doing**

  

As a key member of the Distribution Strategy team for Personal Banking and Imperial Service, you’ll help shape the strategy and priorities for CIBC’s banking centre and advisor channels. Reporting to the Senior Director, Distribution Strategy \& Enablement, you’ll lead high\-priority strategic and financial management work that supports growth, productivity, and stronger client and advisor experiences. Under the new CIBC Way operating model, the Distribution Strategy team supports the Banking Centre Distribution \& Mass Affluent domain and is part of the Portfolio Value \& Financial Management Centre of Excellence. In this role, you’ll connect channel strategy with portfolio\-level insights and investment decisions, identify opportunities, and develop data\-driven recommendations that help senior leaders prioritize investments and maximize value. You’ll partner with Crew Leads, Product Owners, Squads, Finance, and other Centres of Excellence to advance strategic priorities. You’ll also lead complex research and analysis, create materials for senior executive forums, and help strengthen the Centre of Excellence’s capabilities, operating practices, and talent.

  

*At CIBC we enable the work environment most optimal for you to thrive in your role. You'll have the flexibility to manage your work activities within a hybrid work arrangement where you'll spend 1\-3 days per week on\-site, while other days will be remote.*

  

**How you'll succeed**

* **Strategy development and decision support \-** Lead the development and evolution of strategies for CIBC’s banking centre and advisor channels. Connect client, market, operational, and financial insights to identify growth and productivity opportunities, establish strategic priorities, and inform multi\-year roadmaps.
* **Financial management and benefit sizing \-** Lead rigorous financial and quantitative assessments of priority initiatives. Apply consistent methodologies, assumptions, tools, and benchmarks to evaluate expected benefits, test the reasonableness of estimates, and strengthen the quality and credibility of investment decisions.
* **Portfolio governance and performance insights \-** Establish an integrated view of the Banking Centre Distribution \& Mass Affluent portfolio, including expected and realized benefits, efficiencies, capacity, key performance indicators, and strategic outcomes. Translate portfolio\-level insights into recommendations that support prioritization, sequencing, and resourcing decisions.
* **Cross\-functional collaboration \-** Partner effectively with Crew Leads, Product Owners, Squads, Finance, Technology, and other Centres of Excellence. Provide strategic and financial expertise, constructive challenge, and decision support while maintaining clear accountabilities across teams.
* **Executive communication and storytelling \-** Synthesize complex financial, strategic, and operational information into clear, compelling narratives. Develop executive materials that articulate the opportunity, supporting evidence, options, trade\-offs, recommendations, and expected impact.
* **Leadership and capability building \-** Provide thought leadership across strategic and financial management priorities while helping strengthen the Centre of Excellence’s capabilities, ways of working, and shared knowledge.
  

**Who you are**

* **You have relevant experience** . You bring 6 to 9 years of experience in strategy, management consulting, financial management, corporate development, or a related field, ideally within financial services. You have a strong track record of developing strategies, assessing complex opportunities, and translating analysis into measurable business outcomes.
* **You have a degree in** business, finance, economics, or a related field. A Master of Business Administration, Chartered Financial Analyst, Chartered Professional Accountant, or another relevant advanced degree or professional designation is an asset.
* **You give meaning to data.** You enjoy investigating complex and ambiguous problems, bringing structure and clarity to uncertainty, and transforming insights into practical recommendations. You can develop and assess financial models, test assumptions, and evaluate the benefits, costs, risks, and trade\-offs associated with investment decisions.
* **Your influence makes a difference.** You can navigate a complex matrix organization, understand different stakeholder perspectives, and build alignment across senior leaders and cross\-functional partners. You influence outcomes with confidence, sound judgment, and strong communication.
* **You are a caring and accountable leader** . You have experience developing and implementing strategic team goals. You have experience coaching employees and inspiring successful team performance.
* **You're digitally savvy.** You have advanced proficiency in PowerPoint and Excel and can develop high\-quality executive materials and robust financial and analytical models. Experience with data visualization, analytics, or artificial intelligence\-enabled productivity tools is an asset.
* **You live your values.** You bring high standards, genuine care to your relationships, and want to grow with an employer that shares your values and brings out your best.

**What CIBC Offers**

At CIBC, your goals are a priority. We start with your strengths and ambitions as an employee and strive to create opportunities to tap into your potential. We aspire to give you a career, rather than just a paycheck.

new_jobs.description:
**Job Description**

**What is the Opportunity?**


This role establishes a strong link between Role Design, Technology partners, and Personal and Commercial Banking partners to enable the optimization, development, and delivery of digital tools and applications used by Canadian Banking advisors.

 **Primary Focus**

* Drive horizontal strategy across all CRM and Branch Platforms to ensure integrated and consistent advisor experiences
* Work across LOBs, including Personal Bank, Commercial and Private Banking on defining strategic vision and transformational roadmap for next generation of use cases and capabilities
* Establishing the rigor for the ongoing management and evolution of the platform and realization of business benefits.
* Identify, assess, and proactively mitigate risks, developing contingency plans and ensure effective risk management across the portfolio.
* Manage budgets and financial planning in collaboration with finance and business management teams.
* Track approved funding spend, forecast future needs, and ensure cost efficiency across the delivery portfolio.
* Define and track product OKRs and KPIs, and drive the team to achieve them
* Ensure incremental adoption of relevant Client360 capabilities and further introduction of capabilities contained within Salesforce Financial Services Cloud®
* Staying up to date with the FSC products roadmap
* Advocate on behalf of the advisor community in the development of enterprise tools further contributing to Advisor efficiency and experience
* Driving collaboration with key internal functional partners
* Responsible for strategic alignment across major, Big Rock/large initiatives and digitization with Client360 Platform.
* Ensure technology roadmaps align with advisor needs, RBC strategic direction and enable engagement across preferred channels
* Establish and maintain strategic governance and reporting across platforms, driving alignment between business objectives and technology delivery

 **Secondary Focus**

* Collaborate with AI team partners to integrate Actionable insights into the Advisor’s path into Client360 (and other Advisor platforms) for enabling pre\-dive, post\-dive and in the moment efficiencies and effectiveness
* Lead rapid POC development cycles with authority to "fail fast / scale fast," designing multi\-agent interactions across vendor agents, enterprise agents, and native/internal agents to AI\-enable advisors through integration to the existing suite of technologies used by advisors
* Act as Integrator to Client360 / Advisor Platform for agentic workflows—owning use case shaping through validated solution patterns, defining success metrics, and driving iteration based on advisor feedback and usage metrics

 **What Will You Do?**

  

* Establish and maintain strategic direction across CRM and Branch Platforms, ensuring consistency and alignment with advisor needs
* Advocate on behalf of the advisor community in enterprise tool development and provide ongoing feedback loops
* Develop business\-centric programs and reporting that enhance daily advisor operations
* Identify stakeholder needs, negotiate priorities across competing interests, and collaborate with developers/partners to implement requirements effectively
* Keep business and technology stakeholders apprised of roadmap status and gather feedback
* Deploy processes and technologies that safeguard Advisors and Clients (compliance and regulatory requirements)
* Conduct advisor research and act as the voice of the Advisor community in platform development
* Negotiate and prioritize enhancements to mitigate technical and financial risk
* Partner with Technology, Procurement, and third\-party vendors to execute strategic initiatives

 **What Do You Need to Succeed?**

 **Must Have:**

* **Deep Expertise in Salesforce Financial Services Cloud (FSC) Capabilities:**


Demonstrates comprehensive knowledge of Salesforce FSC platform architecture, features, and capabilities (e.g., financial account management, financial deals, wealth management, customer data platforms). The ideal candidate should have hands\-on experience leveraging FSC to drive business outcomes, understand current and emerging FSC capabilities, and possess the ability to assess how these capabilities can inform and accelerate the evolution of Client360\. This includes staying current with Salesforce product roadmaps and identifying opportunities to integrate new FSC innovations into Client360's strategic direction.

* **Business Strategy \& Bridge from Strategy to Implementation**


Exhibits strong strategic thinking combined with pragmatic execution capabilities. The candidate must be able to develop comprehensive business strategies aligned with organizational objectives while maintaining a keen understanding of implementation realities. This includes translating strategic visions into actionable roadmaps, managing stakeholder expectations, prioritizing initiatives based on business impact and resource constraints, and ensuring accountability for delivery. Experience in leading cross\-functional teams to execute complex transformation programs is essential.

* **Expert\-Level Understanding of Client360 – Depth of Implemented Capabilities**


Possesses deep, hands\-on knowledge of Client360's current functionality, architecture, and implementations across diverse user groups and business units. The candidate should understand how different user personas leverage Client360, identify capability gaps, recognize overlaps, and articulate both strengths and limitations. This expertise enables informed decision\-making about platform enhancements, feature prioritization, and strategic investments. The ability to draw on real\-world implementation examples to validate strategy is critical.

* **Exceptional Executive Communication \& Presentation Skills**


Capable of distilling complex technical and strategic concepts into compelling, clear narratives for C\-suite and board\-level audiences.
